fusions.name: Relentless Quiver
fusions.desc: Looses an arrow that deals 6 damage to the first enemy it meets. Holds 5 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Canter Volley
fusions.desc: Looses 3 arrows at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage. Your movement speed rises 15% for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Second Wind
fusions.desc: Restores 3 stamina a second for 8 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Never Winded
fusions.desc: Each time you spend stamina, you recover 2 stamina a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
